canonicalEvidence.fileSet: 5 category evidence files (source of truth; distinct captured identifiers)

allCommittedViews.fileSet: 5 evidence + all-sanitized + benchmark + model-inputs + model-labels + review-queue (CROSS-VIEW occurrences of the same placeholders; NOT distinct identifiers)

idMapping.note: Two explicitly-named metrics: canonicalEvidence scans the 5 category evidence files only (distinct captured identifiers); allCommittedViews scans every committed data view (evidence + derived) and counts CROSS-VIEW occurrences of the SAME placeholders -- allCommittedViews.totalMappedOccurrences is NOT the number of distinct identifiers (derived views re-project the same identifiers). manifest/verification-report/privacy-audit-report are all produced from one shared computation (dataset-files.js buildIdMappingReport) so the same metric name has the same value everywhere. legacyPlaceholderRemapped=true means prior sequential placeholders were re-mapped through HMAC(salt, "legacy:"+old); the original resource id is gone (opaque remap, not recovery). bodiesOmittedReason is the sorted union of per-sample bodyOmittedReason; bodiesOmittedReasonBreakdown is the machine-readable per-reason count. omittedBodiesWithUnknownRetainedLength counts partial-fragment omissions whose pre-omission retained bytes are 0 (unrecoverable historical damage; 0 = UNKNOWN length, not a real 0-length body).

passGate.description: failCount = schema + semantic + privacy + dupId + benchmarkLeak + alignment + manifest + structural + reviewQueue + bodyOmission. A PASS requires every term == 0; any non-zero term is a real defect, not a tolerated warning.
